name: Blind
overview: The Bible addresses blindness both physically and spiritually, emphasizing compassion and justice for the blind as commanded in Leviticus 19:14 and Deuteronomy 27:18, which forbid causing harm or leading the blind astray. Jesus’ healing of a man blind from birth (John 9:1) illustrates God's power to restore sight and faith. Additionally, Luke 14:13 highlights the call to include and care for the blind among the vulnerable. The topic also touches on blind faith and idolatry, as seen in Isaiah 44:17, where misguided worship is depicted as spiritual blindness. The enmity of the Jebusites, hated by David, reflects the broader biblical theme of opposition to God's people.
